scope: CPU-only actual generated mesh topology diagnostic; no repair/rewrite/NN
limits: Exact-position identification is a diagnostic only, not a modification or epsilon weld.
No boundary edges does not exclude closed manifold handles/tunnels. A visible opening can be a manifold tunnel, a boundary, or occlusion.
Vertex links are checked for connected cycle/path structure; main genus with boundaries is reported separately when manifold.
Coordinates/perimeters are normalized model units, not physical metres.
